name: Weekly competitor winning Google Ads → Notion database

parameters.content:
## Setup (2 minutes)
1. **Run Google Ads Transparency**: replace `YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (Apify Console → Settings → API & Integrations) and your 5 competitor websites / country in the JSON body.
2. Notion: create an integration (notion.so/my-integrations), share your database with it, and set `YOUR_NOTION_TOKEN` and `YOUR_DATABASE_ID` in the last node. Database properties: **Name** (title), **Competitor** (text), **Type** (select), **Format** (select), **Days active** (number), **First shown** (date), **Link** (URL).
3. Activate. Runs every Monday at 08:00.

Cost: about $0.25 per week for 5 competitors × 50 ads on the Apify free plan ($5 credit per month). Actor: https://apify.com/xsi/google-ads-transparency

nodes.name: Keep new winning ads (30+ days) and launches

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: 'YOUR_DATABASE_ID' }, properties: { Name: { title: [{ text: { content: ($json.headline || $json.format + ' ad').slice(0, 200) } }] }, Competitor: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.inputDomain } }] }, Type: { select: { name: $json.reportType } }, Format: { select: { name: $json.format } }, 'Days active': { number: $json.daysActive }, 'First shown': { date: { start: $json.firstShownDate } }, Link: { url: $json.transparencyUrl } } }) }}
